name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 7 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-04-06, at wavelengths from 0.91 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
